items.q: How do we start a project with Linse?
items.a: Send us a short brief through “Start a project”. We reply within two working days with questions, then a scoped proposal with timeline and price.

items.q: Do you maintain the systems you build?
items.a: Yes. Every build comes with a support option: monitoring, updates, hosting and a help desk with agreed response times.
Yes. We deliver and install across Rwanda, and ship to the region on request. Warranty is handled by us, locally.

items.q: Can you work with our existing software?
items.a: That is most of what we do: integrating ERP, HMIS, payment and government systems so they share data reliably.

items.q: Do you license your own products?
items.a: Yes. Products we publish, such as MacyePay, are available under licence or as a managed service.
Kigali, Rwanda. We work with clients across East Africa and remotely.
